title: Design and Modeling of a HASEL Actuator-Based Micro Parallel Robot
summary: This paper presents the mechatronic design, dynamic modeling, and experimental validation of a three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) micro parallel robot featuring a prismatic-spherical (3PS) topology actuated by three Hydraulically Amplified Self-Healing Electrostatic (HASEL) actuators. Each soft actuator provides the prismatic motion of an individual limb, while a compliant interface to the moving platform functions as a spherical joint.
